The National Identification Authority's legal head said the banking, social and health sectors all verify identity against the Ghana card.

facts.fact: The National Identification Authority's legal head said Ghana's Ghana card system is in year seven of a 15-year public-private partnership and is used for identity verification.
Kenya's Secretary of National Registration said the first identity card is issued free and the national bureau charges fees for replacements.
NIMC's director general said the commission charges for enrolment and modification of details and for a self-modification platform.

The National Identification Authority's legal head said banking, social and health sectors verify identities against the Ghana card to pay claims or render services, each paying a small fee into escrow.
The same official named the banking, social and health sectors as using Ghana card verification.

KEN.note: Verification fees only advocated, no service named.
